messages:
Maria: Quick sync — want to lock the minimal GA acceptance items for the new inference feature. I grouped into SLA, docs, support, monitoring, pricing. Can owners confirm gaps?
Ajay: I can take SLA and rollout policy. Proposal: two-tier SLA at GA — Bronze (best-effort, no uptime SLA) and Gold (99.9% uptime, reserved capacity). Gold requires Dedicated or Private.
Kevin: Sound reasonable. Need explicit latency SLOs for Gold: p95 < 250ms for 1–2 token responses, p95 < 800ms for 512-token workloads. Also define maintenance windows and allowed downtime for upgrades.
Maria: @Kevin — can you draft exact SLO language we can paste in the contract? Also call out measurement method (per-request, exclude client-side).
Kevin: Will do. Also: alerting thresholds for SRE — error rate > 0.5% sustained 5m, tail latency increases 2x baseline.
Lina: Docs: I have a GA doc skeleton (owner, rollout steps, troubleshooting, runbooks). Need the SLA wording and the oncall runbook content from SRE. ETA for first draft: EOD tomorrow if Kevin gives SLO bullets.
Sam: Support readiness: we'll need an escalation tree, canned responses for 5 common customer issues (auth, quota, model mismatch, high latency, unexpected outputs). Also a training session for Level 1 at GA-3 days.
Ajay: Agree. For canary we should gate Gold customers until canary runs for 48h with no P1. Bronze can be broader.
Maria: Pricing: finance suggests a two-part model: usage + reserved capacity discount. We need a doc section mapping SLA tiers to pricing tiers. @Ajay can you outline the constraints (capacity, billing window)?
Ajay: I'll add a short matrix: Bronze = pay-as-you-go, no reservation; Gold = monthly reservation with a usage multiplier and commit discount. Need finance signoff.
Lina: I'll add a 'what to expect' table in docs for latency and pricing examples so sales can share with customers.
Kevin: On monitoring — dashboards required: global latency histogram, per-model p95/p99, request volume by customer, cache hit ratio, tail KV-cache miss. Also synthetic smoke every minute per-region.
Maria: Good. Who owns runbooks for network/perm errors vs model regressions?
Kevin: SRE owns infra/network, product/ML owns model regressions runbook. I'll add cross-link to ML runbook.
Sam: For support tooling: add a link to the 'debugging' ticket template that includes model_version, model_variant, seed prompt, KV-cache state, recent requests.
Ajay: One more: rollback policy — immediate rollback to previous pinned model if >2customers report P1 within 30m OR error-rate >2% for 15m. Document the communication cadence (status page + customer email).
Maria: Action items: Ajay draft SLA/pricing matrix (tomorrow AM), Kevin draft SLO + monitoring thresholds (EOD), Lina wire doc skeleton + customer-facing examples (EOD), Sam prep L1 training checklist + ticket templates (EOD). I'll coordinate legal/finance signoffs.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary cohort start 2026-04-02T09:00Z. Auto-rollback enabled.
Maria: Let's reconvene 24h after the canary start for final GA decision. If all owners hit their deliverables, we proceed to GA-1 week prep. Thanks everyone :rocket:
Ajay: noted. Adding items to the launch board now.
Kevin: I'll post the draft SLO PR in #eng-sre when ready.
Lina: I'll create the docs PR and ping marketing for customer comms copy.
Sam: Creating the training session event and invite lists now.
